name: Miko-san de She See
source:
Main character loses orientation in the mountains. He discovers a shrine and has to spend there three days during secret festival until the priest arrives. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在山中迷失方向。他发现了一座神社，在神官抵达前，不得不于秘密祭典期间在那里度过三天。

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
